scenario: Fiona works a portfolio and rate question from the morning signal to a recommended action for leadership.
timeframe: Today this is days; the demo compresses it to one session.

phases.name: Monitor
phases.action: Scan balances, delinquency, and deposits for anything moving
phases.thought: Is anything drifting that I will have to explain later?
painPoints: No single view; drift is caught late, in the monthly review
phases.opportunity: Overnight signals surface the pool and the limit before she asks
phases.momentLabel: The morning the drift is caught early rather than late

phases.name: Assess against limits
phases.action: Line up portfolio balances against board risk-tolerance limits
phases.thought: How much headroom is left before we hit a board cap?
painPoints: Limits live in policy documents, not next to the numbers
phases.opportunity: One reconciled figure against the limit with headroom shown

phases.name: Model scenarios
phases.action: Rebuild the shutdown or what-if scenario and read the impact
phases.thought: What does a 30-day shutdown do to delinquency, net worth, and liquidity?
painPoints: Slow to rebuild; hard to trust the cushion
phases.opportunity: Instant scenario with a provable capital and liquidity read
phases.momentLabel: The moment the cushion is proven rather than chased

phases.name: Prepare and decide
phases.emotionLabel: Can I stand behind the number?
phases.action: Assemble the deck, find the playbook action, recommend
phases.thought: What is the pre-agreed play, and can I stand behind the number?
painPoints: Playbook is separate from the analysis; assembly eats the day
phases.opportunity: The action sits next to the analysis; recommend the same morning
phases.momentLabel: The moment the recommended action appears next to the number

traceability.signal: A portfolio nearing a board risk-tolerance limit
